subject: Road to commit: success criteria, exit gates & acceptance checks
messages:
From: Alex Reed <alex@novacentrix.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example>
Cc: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@novacentrix.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Road to commit — high level asks

Lauren — thanks again for the demo this morning. We had a strong exec sync and procurement asked for a concise MAP + acceptance test surface so legal and SRE can sign off.

High level ask: can you give us a one-page MAP with concrete success criteria, owners, and the minimal acceptance tests that show we can commit within a 6-week POC? Procurement would like explicit exit gates (pass/fail) so they can map to contract milestones.

I attached the list of internal stakeholders.

Best,
Alex

--
Alex Reed
Director, ML Platform
Novacentrix
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example>
To: Alex Reed <alex@novacentrix.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.example>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.example>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Road to commit: success criteria, exit gates & acceptance checks

Alex — thanks, happy to do that. I looped in Ben for commercial timelines, Aditya for technical acceptance tests, and Grace for onboarding/CS ownership. We'll draft a compact MAP and a smoke test catalog and aim to deliver by EOD Friday.

Proposed structure for the MAP we will share:
- Goal (what commit looks like)
- Success criteria (quantitative + qualitative)
- Exit gates (hard pass/fail)
- Acceptance tests (owner, inputs, pass criteria)
- Timeline & owners (week-by-week)
- Contingencies / rollback

Attachments: we'll share a one-tab MAP (Novacentrix_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short acceptance-smoke-tests.md.

Is a 6-week POC still the target from your side? If you need a shorter runway we can propose a focused 3-week smoke-first path.

Thanks,
Lauren

--
Lauren Bishop
Head of Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.example>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.example>
Cc: Alex Reed <alex@novacentrix.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Road to commit: success criteria, exit gates & acceptance checks

Lauren / team — quick commercial note for the MAP: if Novacentrix needs SLA-backed latency for production (p95 < 200ms) that will move them to a Dedicated SKU. For the POC we can run hosted with a performance profile that simulates production using a 2x-traffic burst window; that should be fine for acceptance tests.

I'll include two timeline options in the MAP:
- 6-week POC (full feature + perf validation) — target commit week 7
- 3-week smoke (core flows validated) — target decision at week 4

We'll call out pricing delta for the Dedicated proof-of-capacity test.

Ben
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.example>
To: Alex Reed <alex@novacentrix.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.example>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: Acceptance tests & exit gates (attached)

Alex — attaching the first pass of the acceptance test catalog (acceptance-smoke-tests.md) and inline summary below. This is intentionally minimal so legal/procurement have clear pass/fail items.

Summary of acceptance tests (POC scope):
1) Latency smoke: p95 generation latency <= 350ms on hosted profile (test harness + 20-min burst). Owner: Redwood Performance (Aditya). Pass: p95 measured across 3 runs < 350ms.
2) Throughput stability: sustained 60 RPS with <2% error rate over 30 minutes. Owner: Novacentrix SRE + Redwood. Pass: <2% errors across 3 runs.
3) Functional fidelity: top-3 prompt flows return expected intent classification and no more than 8% hallucination on benchmark prompts. Owner: Novacentrix ML Lead (Alex). Pass: pre-agreed prompt set agreement.
4) Data handling & privacy: logs redaction verified; audit log shows no PII for sample requests. Owner: Novacentrix Compliance + Redwood Security. Pass: audit review signoff.
5) Cutover smoke (optional for 6-week): deploy model variant on Dedicated pool and verify end-to-end transaction under 200ms for 95th percentile. Owner: Redwood Ops / Novacentrix Cloud Eng. Pass: single run verification.

Exit gates (hard stops):
- Any single critical test failing twice => STOP and remediation (no commit).
- Security issues flagged by compliance (data exfiltration, missing KMS) => STOP.

I also added a week-by-week checklist in the attachment mapping owners and docs. Please review and flag anything missing.

Aditya
Senior Performance Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: acceptance-smoke-tests.md (see Drive link)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example>
To: Alex Reed <alex@novacentrix.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.example>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.example>
Date: Fri, 9 Sep 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Final MAP & 6-week commit path — deliverables and owners

Alex / team — attached is the finalized one-pager MAP (Novacentrix_MAP_v1.xlsx) and the smoke-test catalog. We cleared the internal review and procurement asked me to share this in a single message for legal sign-off. Summary below: 

Goal (commit definition): Novacentrix will sign a contract when the 6-week POC meets all acceptance tests and at least one production-like load cutover demonstrates p95 <= 200ms on Dedicated (if they opt for Dedicated).

Success criteria (must all be satisfied):
- Latency: p95 <= 350ms on hosted for acceptance runs (Aditya).
- Throughput: sustained 60 RPS with <2% errors (Novacentrix SRE).
- Functional: <8% hallucination on agreed prompt set (Novacentrix ML).
- Compliance: audit log redaction & KMS validated (Grace + Redwood Sec).
- Integration: API contract and authentication exchange completed (Alex owns).

Exit gates (will block commit):
- Repeated performance failures (2 failed runs)
- Any open high-severity security item
- Integration auth not complete by the end of Week 5

Acceptance test owners and timeline (week-by-week brief):
- Week 0 (kickoff): finalize prompt set, test harness, and access (Owners: Alex, Grace, Aditya)
- Week 1–2: smoke functional + latency runs (Owner: Aditya; data: acceptance-smoke-tests.md)
- Week 3–4: stability runs and policy/audit checks (Owners: Novacentrix SRE, Grace)
- Week 5: optional Dedicated cutover test (Owners: Redwood Ops, Novacentrix Cloud Eng)
- Week 6: sign-off window and contract execution (Owners: Alex, Procurement)

Contingencies: If any hard exit gate trips, we'll run a 5-business-day remediation sprint with clear RCA and re-run plan. If remediation can't close within the sprint and the issue is high-severity, both parties may mutually agree to extend POC or pause.

Next steps for procurement: Lauren/Ben to send redline-friendly clause language; Alex to confirm internal signatories.

If this looks good I'll push the final MAP to the shared Drive and notify procurement.

Thanks — and quick thumbs-up requested from Alex and Marta so procurement has the paper trail.

Regards,
Lauren
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
